scripts.pre-generate-models: cross-env-shell openapi-generator-cli generate --input-spec https://${CODEGEN_ENVIRONMENT}.jooxter.com/spring/v3/api-docs/v3 --generator-name typescript-angular --output .codegen --global-property models --type-mappings Date=string --skip-validate-spec --additional-properties=stringEnums=true
scripts.codegen:staging: cross-env CODEGEN_ENVIRONMENT=staging npm run pre-generate-models && shx rm -f src/model/* && shx mv .codegen/model/* src/model/ && shx rm -rf .codegen
scripts.codegen:preprod: cross-env CODEGEN_ENVIRONMENT=preprod npm run pre-generate-models && shx rm -f src/model/* && shx mv .codegen/model/* src/model/ && shx rm -rf .codegen
scripts.codegen:prod: cross-env CODEGEN_ENVIRONMENT=app npm run pre-generate-models && shx rm -f src/model/* && shx mv .codegen/model/* src/model/ && shx rm -rf .codegen
scripts.make-public-api:staging: npm run make-public-api-services && npm run build:models
scripts.make-public-api:preprod: npm run make-public-api-services && npm run build:models
scripts.make-public-api:prod: npm run make-public-api-services && npm run build:models
